title.text: Phase 3 extraction and synthesis: UX wireframes

x1.text: X1: there is no full-text step. The pipeline goes from title/abstract includes straight to extraction (coordinator.py). Reports not retrieved and full-text exclusions with reasons, both required by PRISMA 2020, are never recorded. Boards 2 and 3.

x2.text: X2: a missing PDF or failed parse becomes an abstract-only document (extraction.py:171), counted in 'documents' like a full text, stage DONE, no journal event (extraction.py:33). It then feeds the matrix and synthesis as equal evidence. Boards 4 and 7.

x3.text: X3: the pipeline passes no LLM to the matrix (pipeline/matrix.py:104), so each cell is the first sentence of the top retrieved passage, cut at the first '.' (rag matrix.py:213). '97.3% accuracy' becomes '97'. Values are snippets, not extracted data, and no one verifies them. Board 5.

x4.text: X4: the 'fallback' retrieval repeats the identical query (rag matrix.py:197-204), and LLM extraction errors are swallowed (matrix.py:229), so a cell silently keeps the snippet.

x5.text: X5: 'entailment' is cosine similarity rescaled to 0-1 (synthesis.py:139): cosine 0.7 is VERIFIED, unrelated text scores 0.5, and a negated claim scores high. Without an LLM the synthesis is the retrieved snippets themselves, so checking them against their own sources is circular; no claims gives a rate of 1.0 (synthesis.py:318). Board 6.

x6.text: X6: synthesis answers only the first research question, from 5 passages (pipeline/synthesis.py:107; synthesis.py:275), and writes it as literature_review.md. RQ2 is silently skipped. Board 6.

x7.text: X7: the citation graph is built but nothing uses it: retrieval gets no boost_dois (pipeline/synthesis.py:21), although the architecture table promises 'PageRank-boosted hybrid retrieval'. The graph client is never closed.

x8.text: X8: a stale-extraction rejection at indexing raises TypeError with no journal row; known and preserved on purpose (indexing.py:42). The user sees a Python error, not the reason. Board 7.

x9.text: X9: the embedding model is fixed in code (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384 dimensions; indexing.py:28): English, general-domain, not chosen per protocol or language.

x10.text: X10 (strengths): the abstract fallback never invents prose; every matrix cell keeps a citation token; retrieval is scoped to one study and never falls back to the whole corpus (rag matrix.py:195); identity comes from the accepted manifest; kit failures propagate with no fabricated success.
